name: Chat SDK
description: Builds chat bots and AI agents that run on Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Telegram and WhatsApp from one TypeScript codebase, for developers shipping multi-platform bots.

skills.name: Platform Adapters
skills.description: Connects one bot to Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp and more through swappable platform adapters.

skills.name: Event Handlers
skills.description: Handles mentions, messages, reactions, slash commands and member joins with type-safe handlers that work across platforms.

skills.name: AI Streaming
skills.description: Streams real-time text responses from AI models and other async sources into chat threads on each platform.

skills.name: Cards and Modals
skills.description: Sends interactive cards with buttons, fields and images, and opens modals that collect structured input with validation.

skills.name: Chat Approvals
skills.description: Pauses a durable workflow until a person approves it in chat, then resumes the workflow with that person's decision.
